generation.scope: The scroll-image center has generators (5,3,4) in weights (1,2,3) and minimal relations (3,6,10,6,10) in weights two to six, computed by two regular sections to a genus-nine hyperelliptic spin ring and a further constant Artin reduction. A free central module with the four arrow actions replaces the triple-overlap bound. On every regular domain in the main finite component mixed quartic/octic parameters now give an all-degree test using paths through 22, central quotient through 21 and Koszul complex through 24.

open_mathematics: Constrain the actual center equations by the divisor class group and local singularity representations, and resolve residual nilpotent and other-component regularity.
